scope: Local FFmpeg normalization of one original synthetic five-minute stereo signal; this is not a network synchronization measurement.
syntheticAttribution: Original signal generated for Duet verification; no external recording or licensed sample used.
rssMethod: resource.getrusage high-water marks: RUSAGE_CHILDREN and RUSAGE_SELF; child maximum includes synthetic fixture generation and normalization.
ffmpegVersion: ffmpeg version 7.1.5-0+deb13u1 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
durationMethod: Complete decoded 48 kHz stereo PCM frame count, excluding Opus pre-skip and final padding.

reproduce.normalizePython: from pathlib import Path; from threading import Event; from duet.media import normalize_audio; print(normalize_audio(Path("original-synthetic.flac"), Path("normalized-synthetic.ogg"), Event(), print))
reproduce.testCommand: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_media.py -v
